description: Needs sign-in: Evaluate a math expression with the Compute Engine. With documentId, the expression sees the definitions of that document, as Graph Paper's own assistant does; without it, an empty scope. Pure: nothing is changed.

documentId.description: The id of a document (from list_documents or search_documents). With it, the expression sees that document's definitions; without it, an empty scope.

latex.description: The expression to evaluate, in LaTeX.

name: evaluate_math
title: Evaluate math
